Callout.Name: Abandoned Campsite
Callout.Message: Campsite abandoned with the belongings still there.
Callout.Advisory: No persons present, tent up several days.

Script.Line: The tent has been up since Tuesday and the zip is open.
There is a sleeping bag in it and a pan outside.
Nobody has been near it and the food is still there.

Lines.Approach: The tent has been up three days and nobody has been in it since Tuesday.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
